messages:
Alex P: Quick preflight for Signalhorn private rollout tomorrow morning — short sync. Need owners + immediate blockers for: egress fallback, cert provisioning/rotation (KMS/HSM), air-gapped image sync, and on-prem ACLs. Status + any hard blockers?
Mira S: I can own certs + KMS integration. FYI HSM policy change required (security sign-off). Filing sec ticket now.
Jamal R: I'll take egress fallback. One caveat: firewall team needs explicit source IP list and service ports. @Pat N can you confirm what format you want?
Sophia L: Image sync ready on our side, but registry signing is failing against sigsvc in the customer's airgapped environment. Quick test I ran: ```./image-sync --target /mnt/usb --verify``` returns signature verify error.
ops-bot: automated smoke: Signalhorn staging smoke passed (runtime up, kv-cache warm). median token latency 45ms, no OOMs. Full report at https://ci.internal/builds/5821
Alex P: Thanks. @Mira please link the sec ticket here. @Jamal can you get the IP list by EOD? Also we need a CR for the canary rollout (10% route) — I'll draft and tag eng-oncall for the approved window.
Mira S: Sec ticket created: https://tickets.internal/9876 — reviewer: security+infra. Note: rotation window needs ~30m maintenance; HSM admin key rotation requires Ops on call to be present.
Jamal R: Firewall wants CIDR block list and egress ports. I'll post the minimal list in 15m. For now proposed ports: 443, 10250 (k8s kubelet), 123 (NTP) if allowed.
Pat N: Ack. We accept CIDR list CSV or CIDR range in the ticket. We'll also stand up a temporary NAT egress while DNS flaps settle.
Sophia L: Another blocker: customer OT network enforces strict NTP and time skew > 2s will cause cert rotation to fail. Can someone confirm NTP reachability from host 10.2.3.4?
devops-bot: NTP check: host 10.2.3.4 -> FAILED (no response to 123/udp). Suggestation: allow outbound UDP 123 to our NTP relay 10.10.10.5 or provide local NTP server.
Alex P: Ok action list: (1) Jamal — egress CIDRs + ports (by EOD). (2) Mira — KMS/HSM sign-off + coordinate ops presence during rotation (link sec ticket). (3) Sophia — continue image-sign debug; create repro steps for sigsvc. (4) Pat — prepare NAT plan and confirm temporary rules. I'll spin up the canary CR and ping eng-oncall for the window once IPs are in. If anyone sees new blockers, drop them here. :eyes: :thumbsup:
Mira S: I'll also add a short runbook blurb in the ticket about the rotation rollback steps.
Jamal R: Posting CIDRs now in the ticket. Also adding note about fallback to hosted egress proxy if NAT isn't available.
Pat N: NAT plan posted in ticket comments, will coordinate with networking shift tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Sophia L: I'll attach the sigsvc debug logs to the ticket and include the failing `openssl` verify output.
Alex P: Great — closing the loop for now. If nothing else, final preflight standup 08:30 PST. Thanks all.
